lede: It was a quiet, scattered day on the web: only one topic managed to surface on two feeds at once. Grand Theft Auto turned up on both Steam, where Grand Theft Auto V Legacy sat at number 11, and YouTube, where the Grand Theft Auto VI launch trailer held the number 8 spot. The sharpest single reading came from the ground rather than the feeds: USGS logged a magnitude 6.9 quake 197 km off Port-Olry, Vanuatu, trailed by a run of strong aftershocks. On Wikipedia, Tom Skerritt drew 406,636 views, half again the next most-read page, with nothing else in the snapshot to explain the pull.
